scope: CPU-only bounded source train/val hover normal-stage stability and motor/sensor response. No model/classifier inference, training, GPU, final-test/Real, threshold tuning or dataset mutation.
selection_rule: Before residual calculation: first3 lexicographic admitted original-normal hover cases per split x SIL/HIL. First1 lexicographic case having both admitted endpoint0/1 labels per split x domain x motor/accelerometer/gyroscope/barometer/magnetometer/GPS. No replacement after residual coverage or result inspection.
mode: hover only; conclusions must not be generalized to other flight modes or all faults. Some cases overlap earlier timing/normal diagnostics and all source-val has prior development exposure, not blind testing.
residual_definition: Reuse validate_kinematic_residuals.py unchanged: fixed200000us horizon, actual native availability-segment ZOH integration, source-observation ages and reset masks, 1m+3rad outputs. Causal delivered-stream diagnostic, not synchronous sensor truth.
windows: Original cap64 and original included source ledger identities only. Every window first10 frames excluded. For feature comparison require original150-frame input/supervision qualification plus all140 joint residual rows valid. Preserve all windows with reasons, never refill.
labels: Keep original endpoint binary labels and qualify references. For response tests use only whole150-frame known-normal pre_fault windows and whole150-frame known-active fault windows; mixed-boundary and post_fault/control-normal phases retained but not folded into pre/post response.
stage: window-end position relative to original crop rows, four fixed quarters. Compare first vs last quarter within normal cases, not claimed physical takeoff/landing.
legacy9: Existing _relation_features calculations on the same current26-channel normalized window, with same frozen source norm and baro subtract-window-start. Deterministic feature computation only; no network forward/weights. Compare same retained140 positions.
features: median of each existing9 heuristic channels
normal_reference_scaling: For descriptive unitless contrasts only, fit median/IQR from admitted selected SOURCE TRAIN ORIGINAL NORMAL windows; apply unchanged to source val. Record zero/near-zeroIQR as unavailable, not epsilon-inflated scores. Do not write model residual stats.
matching: For each fault case, compare full-active windows with selected independent normal windows in same split/domain/hover/original-crop-quarter. Report per-quarter and per-case weighted AUC (larger predefined feature=>fault); do not optimize signs/thresholds or pick best feature. Matching is coarse and observational, not causal equivalence.
reports: normal per-case early/late medians and P95, diagnostic IQR-standardized changes
new4 component and2 magnitude score distributions plus legacy9
per-fault-subtype pre/active changes and independent-normal matched AUC/counts
coverage/exclusions, reset counts, observation age/skew and per-case uncertainty limits
stop_boundary: Exactly selected36 cases. No resampling/horizon/age tuning, no model changes, no Real/internal-test, no graph model, no automatic git push. CPU duration measured, not promised10 seconds.
